_comment: Ville de Montreal open data, read by mapsee_ingest_montreal_loisirs.py through the CKAN datastore API (a documented public API: catalog_curate.DOCUMENTED_API_TYPES has ckan; robots.txt Disallows /api/ and asks Crawl-delay 10, which the reader honours anyway). Read the adapter header before changing a rule: only sessions anyone can turn up to are written, and every price sentence is read by ../mapsee migration 0227 as an offer tag.
attribution: Source : Ville de Montréal, « Programmation de sports et loisirs disponible via Loisirs Montréal », données ouvertes sous licence CC BY 4.0.
_timezone: Montreal keeps Toronto's rules; America/Montreal is only a backward-compatible link in tzdata.
_bbox: south, west, north, east: the island and its bridges. A point outside it is a parse gone wrong, not a site.
_site_check_km: A site whose point lies further than this from most other sites sharing its postal area (FSA) is refused: the City geocodes a street without its borough (adapter: contradicted_points).
_skip_dates: Quebec's statutory holidays (Action de grâce, Noël, Jour de l'An, Vendredi saint, lundi de Pâques, Journée nationale des patriotes, Fête nationale, Fête du Canada, Fête du Travail). The dataset carries no holiday closures; Camp Énergie's own text says 'Congé : 7 septembre et 12 octobre'. The adapter warns when the list ends before the horizon.

sources.name: Loisirs Montréal - sessions sans inscription
sources._info_url: The data has no per-activity link; Loisirs Montréal is where the City publishes each activity.
sources._resource: Programmation de sports et loisirs (année en cours), CSV mirrored into the datastore (datastore_active true), rebuilt daily. The '3 dernières années' resource is the same rows plus the past.
sources._kids_age_max: A band ending at 13 or younger adds the kids door. The libraries' 5-13 and 7-13 programmes (chess, video games, a Pokemon trade) are children's; at 12 only the one whose title the sync reads reached it.
